claims.text: Available labels for antisocial events in datasets include harassment, cyberbullying, hate speech, personal attacks, and general toxicity.
The datasets used for forecasting antisocial events include conversations from Wikipedia and the subreddit ChangeMyView, which focus on different aspects of moderation.
